title: Record the screen to a video file
summary: Start a screen recording and save it as a video file. Stop the recording by pressing Ctrl+C in the terminal.

steps.explain: Run the screencapture command with the -v flag and the path for the video file. The recording starts immediately.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The full path and filename for the video, e.g., ~/Desktop/recording.mp4

steps.expect: The terminal will wait for input. Press Ctrl+C to stop the recording.
